trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn all other 54 trophies in GTA VI singleplayer to unlock the platinum, since no multiplayer and no DLC trophies are required [1][2]. The list totals 55 trophies - 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze - and 28 of them stay hidden on PSN until earned [1][2]. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, while PlayStationTrophies rates it 7/10 mainly because of the drone time trials [1][4]. PlayHub maps the same list onto the 100% completion requirements [5].
steps: Finish the story once and keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter, because the game has no mission replay [1].
Clear the 100% completion checklist, the single biggest requirement, then mop up the Strangers and Freaks strands [1][5].
Bank the one potentially missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude's Chapter 1 meditation, during the story run [1].
The platinum pops automatically the moment the last of the 54 trophies lands [1][3].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion through the pause-menu checklist, which only becomes viewable after the story [1][2]. The requirements are lenient - roughly 60% of true completion - and nothing toward the checklist is missable [1][2]. The big chunks are any 70 of 80 challenges, all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, 15 of 15 Target Decks, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied [2][3].
steps: Finish the story first, since the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the credits [1][2].
Work the checklist in chunks: robberies, gang operations, challenges, scans and studies [2][3].
Nothing is missable, so leave the cleanup for free-roam [1].
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100% [1][4].

trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once and the trophy pops on the last one [1]. Clear the rare ones deliberately: golf, pool and basketball [1].
The story and the 100% checklist will cover the rest automatically [1].

The confirmed counters are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the character strands with their own trophies - Kenton, Bret, Andy, Billy, Tyrone - do not count here [1][2]. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many have registered [1].
steps: Clear Kirk's 3-quest Skunk Ape chain, startable in Chapter 1 [2].
Clear Kyle's 3-quest chain in Chapter 2 [2].
Clear Yago's 4-quest racing chain in Chapter 3 [2].
Clear Pilot Pete's deliveries in Chapter 4 [2].
The trophy pops when the 8th counted strand ends [1][3].

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida's 10 locations and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. Choose Accept to bank the Chapter 1 exclusive meditation [1].
Sweep the other 17 spots across the 10 locations, tracking under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations [1][2].
The trophy pops on the 18th spot [1][4].

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile, and the trophy unlocks [1]. Every robbery, stealth clear, takedown and escape feeds the counter, and the trophy list shows your progress out of 500 [1]. Most players bank it passively while working the 100% checklist [1].
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile [1].
Play normally - robberies, clean escapes and combat all add actions [1].
If short at the end, farm by running over civilians and cops with a car [1].
The trophy pops at 500 actions [1][3].
trophies.window: The counter runs the whole game and nothing expires [1]; our flag treats the story run as the window, so keep profile notifications on and let every mission feed the 500 [1][2].

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg and the trophy unlocks [1][2]. The spot is the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2:00 AM, and you must come solo [1][2]. The spawn is slightly random, so keep circling until the blinking car appears [1][2].
steps: At night after 2:00 AM, drive alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County [1][2].
If no blinking car is parked, drive away and return until one spawns [2].
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO and approach the blue light [1][2].
Talk to the abducted woman, walk her back to her car, and the trophy unlocks [1][2].
trophies.window: The trigger only appears at night after 2:00 AM, solo [1][2]; a no-show night never locks the trophy, but only a solo night visit at that road can fire it [1].
